excerpt: The central rule of this framework is simple: software is not production ready merely because it runs. AI assisted development and vibe coding can accelerate implementation, but speed of implementation does not prove security, privacy, compliance, correctness, reliability, scalability, accessibility, supportability, recoverability, or legal readiness.
